address_quote: University Center 142 Nunn Drive Highland Heights, KY 41099

facts.text: Free interview and everyday clothing is offered to NKU students in University Center 142. Students must bring their All Card to shop.
quote: The Care Closet @ NKU offers free clothing to assist NKU students in finding appropriate interview wear and everyday needs. Visit our location University Center 142.
Students must have their All Card to shop with us.

facts.text: Students can arrange an appointment outside operating hours. Graduate and law students needing an appointment are directed to carecloset@nku.edu.
quote: Students can come to the Care Closet @ NKU during the open hours of operation or schedule an appointment with the Assistant Coordinator to visit the space outside of operating hours.
Are you a graduate or law student needing an appointment? Email us at carecloset@nku.edu

facts.text: The published hours panel is explicitly for Spring 2026: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., closed during on-campus events. Confirm this term’s hours before travelling.
facts.quote: Spring 2026 Hours UC 142 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday: 11am - 3pm *We will be closed during on-campus events

facts.text: There is no visit-frequency limit, but students are asked to take only what they need and bring a reusable bag.
quote: We no longer have a limit on how often you can visit the Care Closet @ NKU; however, we ask that you keep in mind that the CC is for everyone at NKU, so please only take what you need!
Please bring your own reusable bag!

facts.text: Students may collect items for other people if they tell the service. Children’s clothing is held at the Newport home base and must be requested for collection at NKU; it is not promised as NKU walk-in stock.
quote: Can I take items for other people? Yes! We just ask that you let us know so we can better understand who we are helping in the community.
We have all kinds of clothes for babies and children of all ages at our home base in Newport. Just complete our online form and we will pull a bag together and arrange to get it to you.
Email Amy Kees to request your items and ask to pick up these items at the Care Closet @ NKU.

facts.text: Clothing donations are not generally accepted at NKU. For a few suitable, clean items in good condition, email a list to carecloset@nku.edu and coordinate a drop-off time; do not assume walk-in donation service.
facts.quote: We do not generally accept clothing donations; however, if you believe that you have a few* items that will benefit our college students, are on-trend, and are clean, in good condition and free of tears or holes, you can email carecloset@nku.edu with a list of donation items. A drop-off time must be coordinated with the Care Closet.

facts.text: NKU links a campus map intended to identify accessible routes and building entrances. It is campus-level orientation and does not describe the indoor connection to Care Closet room UC 142.
facts.quote: The campus map is designed to indicate the most accessible routes and entrances to buildings on NKU's campus.

facts.text: For visitors using designated disability spaces, NKU requires both a state-issued disability placard and a Parking Services permit. Its Nunn Drive office lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; summer hours may vary. Confirm arrangements at 859-572-5505.
quote: Handicap spaces are available to visitors with ADA needs. These spaces require a valid state issued handicap placard and a permit issued by Parking Services.
Please stop by the Parking Services on Nunn Drive between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. to obtain a permit Monday-Thursday or 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. on Friday (summer hours may vary).
If you have specific visitor parking questions please call us at (859) 572-5505.

facts.text: Visitor garages are Arena, University and Kenton. Pull a ticket even if the gate is raised; payment accepts Visa, MasterCard or Discover. The 2026–27 table lists $12 for stays over four hours or a lost ticket. Departmental validation is possible but not promised for this service.
quote: Visitor parking is located in the Arena Garage, University Garage, and Kenton Garages
Always pull a ticket as you enter the garage, even if the gates are up.
Garages accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover
Some departments validate parking, be sure to check with department prior to heading back to vehicle.
Garage Rates (26-27)
4.0 Hours + $12.00 Lost Ticket $12.00

facts.text: Surface lots require a permit. A visitor day permit can be bought online for $12, printed and displayed on the dashboard; it applies only to the registered vehicle in Student Parking or Permit Parking lots.
quote: All vehicles must possess a permit to park in surface lots.
Visitors can purchase a pass from the parking office or visitors can purchase a printable day permit online for $12/day.
The permit must be displayed on your dashboard and can only be used in the Student Parking or Permit Parking lots. The permit can only be used in the vehicle that was assigned to the permit.
